profile.name: Alkem Laboratories Ltd
profile.founded: 1973, Mumbai, by brothers Samprada Singh (d. 2019) and Basudeo Narain (B.N.) Singh
profile.listed: NSE/BSE, 23-Dec-2015 (IPO at ₹1,050, an offer for sale by shareholders)
profile.employees: 19,253 permanent employees in the parent company (Mar-26); field force 14,500+ in India excluding line managers
profile.plants: 20 manufacturing sites: 18 in India (Sikkim x5 complexes incl. the largest seven-unit site, Baddi, Daman, Mandva, Ankleshwar, Taloja and others), 2 in the US (S&B Pharma API, California; Enzene Inc., New Jersey); R&D at Taloja, Navi Mumbai and San Diego
profile.rank: #6 in the Indian pharmaceutical market by value (IQVIA MAT Mar-26, market share ~4.1%), #3 by prescriptions (SMSRC MAT Feb-26), #1 in anti-infectives for 15+ years, #2 in VMN, #3 in pain, #4 in gastro; #1 or #2 in trade generics

q1fy27.therapyMultiples: Anti-infectives 1.1x the market, gastro 1.2x, VMN 1.4x, pain 1.8x, anti-diabetic 1.4x, respiratory 1.6x, derma 1.6x
q1fy27.branded: Branded generics +12%; trade generics flat (Jan-Jun 2026 high single digit; tighter credit days and price increases after API inflation). Ex-trade generics: price +6%, new launches +3%, volume +2%
q1fy27.usNote: 5 ANDA approvals (1 tentative); 192 ANDAs filed, 170 approved incl. 18 tentative (Jun-26); no volume growth in recent launches, price erosion 'close to flattish'
q1fy27.newBiz: Enzene US CDMO opex ~₹60 cr a quarter, breakeven needs $25-30mn of annual sales (FY28), not within 12 months; ortho MedTech EBITDA loss ₹5-7 cr in Q1, ~₹50 cr annual sales; Occlutech closed mid-July: target ~₹400 cr sales in FY27 at breakeven EBITDA; Enzene India: 7 biosimilars, ~₹150 cr annual sales, profitable

governance.board: 15 directors in FY26: six executive directors from the promoter family, nine independent directors (three rotated off on 12-Jul-2025, three joined on 13-Jul-2025)
governance.auditor: Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP (unmodified opinion FY26)
governance.pay: KMP remuneration ₹117.4 cr in FY26 (incl. the CEO, CFO and CS) plus ₹17.9 cr to close relatives: ~5.9% of profit to owners. Executive Chairman's pay is 425x the median employee, the MD's 335x
governance.incomeTax: Income-tax search in Sep-2023; a Feb-2024 press report citing unnamed officials alleged over ₹1,000 cr of bogus Sikkim (80-IC/80-IE) deductions and unaccounted payments to doctors (unverified; no charge sheet found). On 30-Jun-2026 CIT(A) deleted 80-IE disallowances of ~₹660.8 cr for AY2018-19 to 2022-23; a ₹333.4 cr demand for AY2023-24 (80-IE and transfer pricing, 13-Apr-2026) was adjusted against MAT credit and is under appeal
governance.family: Two branches (B.N. Singh's and the late Samprada Singh's). A family settlement among Samprada Singh's lineal descendants was disclosed to BSE (2024; terms not retrieved); promoter-group members have sold: Jayanti Sinha 1.42% (Jun-2025), Jayanti Sinha and the Samprada & Nanhamati Singh Family Trust ~1.49% at ₹5,200 (2-Jun-2026, 90-day lock-up); some members reclassified to public (exchange approval 15-Jul-2025)
governance.succession: Founder in his mid-80s; MD is third-generation; the professional CEO left in Jun-2026 and the post was vacant on 30-Sep-2026; non-pharma businesses (Enzene, MedTech) report to promoter executives, not the CEO

enzene.what: Biosimilars (8 products in India, e.g. teriparatide, denosumab, pertuzumab; ~₹150 cr a year, profitable) and a monoclonal-antibody CDMO in Pune and New Jersey (EnzeneX continuous manufacturing)
enzene.fy26: Revenue ₹492.3 cr, loss ₹150.5 cr (AR FY26 note 3.37); US CDMO revenue under ₹100 cr in FY26
enzene.funding: Eight Roads Ventures and F-Prime Capital bought a minority stake in Dec-2022 (with an exit liability on Alkem, ₹161.5 cr carried in NCI transactions); on 13-Feb-2026 F-Prime and ERVI Healthcare put in ₹26.2 cr for Series B CCPS at ₹468.60 a share. Fully diluted: Alkem 88.99%, Eight Roads 5.42%, F-Prime 1.87%, ERVI 0.71%
enzene.impliedValueWhy: ₹468.60 × ~6.01 cr fully diluted shares (Alkem's 5.349 cr equity shares = 88.99%) = ~₹2,817 cr for 100% (post-money); GAM calculation
enzene.listing: No IPO or listing plan for Enzene was announced by 30-Sep-2026 (none found in filings or calls)
enzene.regulatory: EMA approval for denosumab (FY26, partner Theramex); US denosumab approval delayed 'by at least a few months' (Q1 call); Xgeva biosimilar launch in Europe ~3 months away (Aug-2026)
enzene.src: AR FY26 pp. 89-93, note 3.37; Reg 30 disclosure 13-Feb-2026: https://admin.alkemlabs.com/uploads/Reg30_Enzene13022026_b512f274dc.pdf; Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 calls

occlutech.what: German-headquartered structural-heart occluder maker (ASD/PFO devices; #2 in Europe; CE and US FDA approvals on flagship products; 200,000+ implants; plants in Germany and Turkey)
occlutech.deal: Board approved up to ₹1,100 cr for 51-55% of Occlutech Holding AG plus ~₹200 cr for its funding needs (13-Feb-2026); ~€99mn for up to 55% (MOSL); closed mid-July 2026
occlutech.financials: CY24 revenue €43mn; CY25E revenue ~€49mn, EBITDA ~€2mn, net loss ~€6.8mn (MOSL company update, 18-Feb-2026)
occlutech.src: AR FY26 secretarial audit report p. 126 and p. 93; MOSL company update (18-Feb-2026, via Business Standard); Q1FY27 call

history.event: Alkem founded in Mumbai by Samprada Singh and B.N. Singh; first plant at Taloja (1978)
First R&D centre (2003); Taxim crosses ₹100 cr (2006); first US ANDA filed (2007), first approval (2009)
Bought Ascend Laboratories (US front end), Pharmacor (Australia), Enzene Biosciences (2011) and a US API plant (S&B Pharma, 2012)
IPO at ₹1,050 (offer for sale; no new money)
history.impact: Listed; the company raised no new money

history.event: US revenue passes $200mn a year (2018); group revenue passes $1bn (2019)
Bad year: US price erosion and US-related charges; EBITDA margin 14%, exceptional items ₹173 cr
Income-tax search; later assessment disallowances of Sikkim deductions (largely deleted on appeal, Jun-2026)
MedTech entry (Exactech licence via Advita Ortho; Bombay Ortho and Adroit Biomed bought); trade generics carved out into Alkem Wellness Ltd
Enzene's $50mn New Jersey CDMO plant opens (operational from Nov-2025)
history.impact: ~₹60 cr a quarter of opex before revenue

history.event: Indore plant sold (gain ₹14 cr); labour-code charge ₹113 cr; real-estate investment impairment ₹75 cr
Day-one launch of generic semaglutide injections in India; ~11% unit share early on
CEO Dr Vikas Gupta leaves; promoter group sells ~1.5% at ₹5,200 (2-Jun)

history.impact: ~₹400 cr of FY27 sales at breakeven EBITDA
